impact: Socket update overwrites order in context. fromAPI.order(socketPayload) produces loyaltyRedeemed=false because loyalty_info absent. If cashier opens CPP after any order edit, loyalty pre-tick is LOST.

fix_options.A_fe_guard: In handleOrderDataEvent (socketHandlers.js): preserve loyaltyRedeemed from existing order if new socket payload has no loyalty_info
fix_options.B_backend_brief: Ask backend to include loyalty_info in update-order socket payload
fix_options.C_cpp_only: CPP mount effect is one-time; if CPP is already open, state is safe. But if CPP opens AFTER socket update, loyalty is lost.

recommended_fix: A (FE guard in socketHandlers.js) — no backend change needed
